images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production-ready 2D game HUD atlas, original dark hand-painted fantasy, precise sculpted metal, fine engraved gold/silver edges and aged materials, polished quality like an elaborate gothic hourglass menu. Create one square 1536 x 1536 RGBA PNG with TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND. EXACTLY SIX completely separate long horizontal BOSS HEALTH-BAR OUTER FRAMES stacked in six equal 256px-high rows. No characters, no environment, no words, no numbers, no labels, no watermarks. All sprites face front, no perspective skew. Each row frame lies within x=24..1512 and row-local y=18..238, long overall silhouette approximately 7:1; leave transparent gaps between rows. Each has identical usable layout: a large empty circular portrait mounting hole at left (centre x=148, row-local y=128, radius=72); a long straight EMPTY TRANSPARENT health channel from x=274 to x=1430, row-local y=120..163; a calm blank transparent name area above the channel at x=290..1340,y=70..106. Draw only a detailed sculpted OUTER SHELL, thin groove rims and left portrait ring; DO NOT fill the portrait hole or channel or name area, DO NOT paint a black rectangle behind them. Decorations can surround these openings but must never cross them. Each row must have distinctly different silhouette and materials associated with its boss, not simple recoloring. Row 1 desert scorpion king: ancient sand-gold bronze, scorpion claws and curving segmented tail at ends, small amber venom crystals, restrained. Row 2 spider queen: sinister silver-purple spider crown, fine violet silk bridging ornamental corners, elegant spider-leg filigree. Row 3 bloodmoon bat lord: crimson gems, dark silver bat wings forming ends, fanged and aristocratic engraved details. Row 4 serpent poison queen: emerald scaled bronze, coiled serpent necks and small fangs framing the ends, translucent jade venom stones. Row 5 molten bull demon: heavy black forged iron, large powerful curved bull horns around the portrait ring, cracked glowing lava-orange insets and embers, dramatic flame-shaped outer ends, NOT obscuring the empty health opening. Row 6 ancient gargoyle: weathered grey stone and tarnished silver, gargoyle wing and ruined bell motifs at ends, cold blue mineral accents. All six must belong to one cohesive game UI family, rich hand-painted material detail, strong clear silhouettes at small display size, restrained localized glows only. No sheet border, no solid background gradients, no checkerboard painted into image. Central openings and all outer negative space must be transparent alpha. The frame shell may be asymmetrical in theme ornament, but keep the common horizontal portrait/name/HP mounting geometry.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production 2D game UI sprite atlas on a perfectly TRANSPARENT RGBA background, square 1536 x 1536. Exactly FIVE distinct long horizontal boss-health OUTER FRAME sprites in five rows; substantial transparent 35px gaps separate every row, nothing touches another row or canvas edge. Full frame silhouettes about 7:1 wide. Hand-painted dark gothic fantasy with high-quality sculpted aged metals, engraving and controlled jewel light; no cartoon, no flat vector. All five frames share exact mounting geometry: one EMPTY circular avatar hole at left, an EMPTY long straight lower health channel from 23% to 93% of frame width, and a thin blank upper name label strip (also transparent). Only rims, outer shell and theme ornaments are painted; ALL holes and background must be perfectly clear alpha, no gray fog, no cloudy smears, no filled black panels, no text, numbers, bars, creatures, backdrop, watermarks or sheet border. The rows, from top to bottom: 1 ANCIENT TREE LORD: twisted dark living wood, golden antler-like root branches, emerald leaves and amber sap crystals; 2 FROST WOLF KING: jagged silver ice, white-blue frost crystal fangs, elegant wolf-tooth motifs, not a whole wolf; 3 THUNDER BONE WYVERN: black iron and gold lightning bones, swept dragon horns, tiny concentrated white-gold lightning accents; 4 FACELESS STAR EMISSARY: indigo-black metal, intricate golden celestial rings and constellation engraving, small sapphire-purple gems, balanced arcane geometry; 5 SKELETON KING: weathered ivory bone crown, dark iron, spectral cold-green flames restrained at outer ends, skull-relief around left portrait ring, no face inside the hole. Keep the entire health-channel interior straight, uncluttered and truly transparent; circular avatar centre is blank transparent too. The natural sculpted shell must be luxurious enough for a premium action RPG, clearly different silhouettes for all five but cohesive craft quality. Front-on orthographic UI with crisp detailed borders. Reserve upper/lower padding around decorations; do not crop antlers, horns or crystals. No solid image background of any kind.
